title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Local AI SOTA: Zhipu's GLM 5.2 model launches with performance rivaling OpenAI's and Anthropic's flagship models, running 100% locally on Apple Silicon and deployed on Ollama via Blackwell GPUs.

US-Iran Negotiations Collapse: Iran halts the 60-day diplomatic talks framework and cancels the Switzerland delegation meeting over Israeli strikes in Lebanon, leading to US Vice President Vance also canceling his travel.
Developer Tools: OpenAI introduces 'Record & Replay' for Codex on macOS, enabling users to record manual desktop workflows and automatically compile them into reusable agent skills.
Regulatory Backlash: Financial circles raise alarm over proposed SEC Rule S7-2026-15, which could allow public companies to delay reporting negative financial metrics for up to six months.
LLM Genealogy: Tech historians trace the roots of China's current AI ecosystem back to the 2018 founding of BAAI (智源) and early scaling law research at Baidu and Tsinghua.

World Cup Drama: Underdog Cape Verde holds Spain to a shocking 0-0 draw, while discussions intensify over Lionel Messi's tactical off-the-ball playstyle versus Cristiano Ronaldo's goal-scoring rigidity.

items.title: @AlexFinn: Local GLM 5.2 Launch
items.body: Zhipu AI has launched GLM 5.2, an open-weights model capable of running locally on Apple Silicon. Early testing indicates performance rivaling proprietary models like Claude Opus 4.8, marking a significant milestone for private, local superintelligence.

items.title: @OpenAIDevs: Codex Record & Replay
items.body: OpenAI has introduced a 'Record & Replay' feature for Codex on macOS. The tool records manual desktop workflows—like filing expenses or submitting requests—and automatically converts them into inspectable, reusable agent skills.

items.title: @pankajkumar_dev: GPT-5.6 Pro Leak
items.body: Leaks suggest OpenAI is preparing to release the GPT-5.6 series by late June. Early testers report massive improvements in SVG and 3D generation, as well as superior image understanding and design replication capabilities.

items.title: @googlecloud: Agent UI Protocol (A2UI)
items.body: Google Cloud has announced support for the Agent-to-UI protocol (A2UI). The protocol enables custom enterprise agents to dynamically generate native, interactive UI components directly within the Gemini Enterprise application.

items.title: @vidyamadhavan2: Perplexity Valuation Surge
items.body: Perplexity AI has reached a $22 billion valuation with a $450 million ARR. Despite lacking the general catchphrase familiarity of ChatGPT or Claude, its massive enterprise adoption has quietly made it one of the most financially successful AI products.

items.title: @allenanalysis: US-Iran Talks Suspended
items.body: Iran has halted its 60-day negotiation framework with the United States and canceled its delegation's trip to Switzerland. Tehran claims recent Israeli strikes in Lebanon violated the first clause of the newly signed memorandum of understanding.

items.title: @keepitquarterly: Delayed Reporting Rule
items.body: Public criticism is mounting against proposed SEC Rule S7-2026-15, which would permit public corporations to withhold negative financial results for up to six months. Critics warn this heavily disadvantages retail investors while enabling corporate insider selling.

items.title: @CodyC64: Protect College Sports Act
items.body: The Protect College Sports Act has passed the Senate Commerce Committee with a 19-9 vote, clearing the way for a potential vote on the Senate floor. The bill marks the first viable bipartisan effort to negotiate federal standards for college sports.

items.title: @DataStorageCorp: DTST Divestiture Highlights
items.body: Data Storage Corp ($DTST) reported strong 2025 results, highlighted by the completion of a $40 million CloudFirst divestiture, a $29.3 million tender offer return to shareholders, and record net income of $19.2 million.

items.title: @FOXSoccer: Cape Verde Holds Spain
items.body: In a historic World Cup upset, underdog Cape Verde held soccer powerhouse Spain to a scoreless 0-0 draw. Goalkeeper Vozinha made several critical saves to secure the points, shocking fans worldwide.

items.title: @Compute_King: China LLM Genealogy
items.body: A deep dive traces the roots of Chinese large language models (like CPM, GLM, and Qwen) back to the 2018 establishment of the non-profit Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI) and early deep learning engineering at Baidu and Tsinghua.

items.title: @ESPNFC: Messi vs. Ronaldo Playstyles
items.body: Pundits analyze the contrasting aging trajectories of Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo. Analysts argue Messi's intelligence and 'off-the-ball' walk-and-stand movement allow him to age better tactically compared to Ronaldo's physical, penalty-box-bound role.

items.title: @FabrizioRomano: Nico Williams Transfer Stance
items.body: Highly coveted forward Nico Williams expressed his loyalty to Athletic Club, stating he would happily sign off on staying with the Spanish club until the end of his career, despite intense transfer speculation from larger European teams.

items.title: @yuniyiqi8848: Huawei Store Courier Policy
items.body: Controversy erupted in Shandong after a delivery courier was barred from entering a Huawei retail store to hand over a phone. The employee insisted the worker wait outside to avoid impacting business, drawing backlash from netizens online.
